# V53 evidence

Owning slice: [V53: Human level one](../../V53-human-level-one.md). Source research:
[the preparation record](../../../research/human-level-one-preparation.md).

**Nothing here has been executed.** No dependency install, build, typecheck, test, server or browser
has run for this unit.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [builds.json](builds.json) | Four builds — three counterparts covering all five purchased traits, plus the H0 control — with per-field expectations derived from the pin, removal expectations, and the loader traps this ancestry carries |
| [test-plan.md](test-plan.md) | Definition, derived-value, entitlement-presence, budget, removal, snapshot and browser cases |

Capture uses the procedure and hardened script pattern settled in V47 and V49: the pinned Forge tree
exported with `git archive` into scratch space and never installed inside `vendor/forge-steel`;
verification by **active selections** rather than substring presence; Save Changes before export;
every sheet page captured; declared provenance recorded separately from the version observed in the
application's own About modal; and an ambiguous selector failing rather than guessing. The script is
written when the capture window is requested, so it is not carried here unexecuted a third time.

## The shape of this unit, in one line

Only Staying Power changes a derived value. That is why H0 exists and why acceptance check 3 asserts
**both** that H2's numbers match H0's **and** that H2's two entitlements are present — identical
numbers alone are also exactly what granting nothing would produce.
